note: Investment office upstairs (repainted 2026-10-22 fix2, realistic B10 bank style: pale grey-blue walls, white mouldings, arched windows, glass bookcases, marble fireplace, grey herringbone parquet). Open door at the left back to the fiscal office, boardroom table at the back (zoom R_bank_economy_04_z1). Feminine LEFT: family pear-tea picnic under a potted fruit tree laden with fruit (prospérité), expert with a loupe appraising a painting while her cat teases her skirt (expertise), prospector panning a tub for nuggets (prospection). Centre: heiress fanning herself with share certificates (actionnaire). Masculine RIGHT: owner in a cap on a pyramid of coins (capitalisme), girl planting a coin from her vest in a flowerpot (investissement), cork popping out of a brass pipe with cheeses tumbling out (débouché), man placing his savings bag in a little safe (placement), stockbreeder lifting a lamb into a little cage lift (éleveur), hyper boy racing a huge trolley (hypermarché).
